prompt: 抓住设定的感觉,想想订单到底代表什么,完成后会有什么样的后果

assertions.name: response_length_sufficient
assertions.description: Response should be >500 Chinese characters to show adequate thinking depth

assertions.name: visible_reasoning_process
assertions.description: Response shows the thinking journey — exploring directions, checking constraints, showing pivots — not just stating conclusions

assertions.name: explores_multiple_angles
assertions.description: Response considers more than one possible interpretation of what orders could represent, rather than jumping to a single answer

assertions.name: no_bare_conclusion
assertions.description: Response is not a bare conclusion (<200 chars would indicate too brief)
